elements.element: Customer must have no obligation to provide Vendor pricing or other terms by reference to more favourable pricing or terms Customer provides to any third party.
elements.evidence: Section 7.2 expressly states that Customer has no obligation to offer Vendor terms no less favourable than those offered to another technology supplier. Section 12.3 also confirms that Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment.

elements.element: Any MFN obligation burdening Customer must be limited to an expressly defined product.
elements.evidence: The rendered language imposes no MFN obligation on Customer, so there is no MFN whose product scope could exceed this fallback limit.

elements.element: Any MFN obligation burdening Customer must be limited to 12 months.
elements.evidence: The rendered language imposes no MFN obligation on Customer, so there is no MFN duration exceeding 12 months.

elements.element: Any MFN obligation burdening Customer must exclude transactions or terms that are not reasonably comparable.
elements.evidence: The rendered language imposes no MFN obligation on Customer, so no comparison obligation arises for either comparable or non-comparable transactions.

result.reason: The operative redline removes the Customer-burdening MFN and aligns Section 7.2 with the existing confirmation in Section 12.3. The fallback restrictions are also satisfied because the MFN condition is demonstrably absent. Only the targeted MFN language is changed, unrelated terms remain intact, and the non-operative margin comment is not relied upon.
